Operations, Compliance & Technology •     Ensure compliance with global pay transparency (including EU Pay Transparency), equal pay, and labor regulations; partner with Legal on new and evolving requirements. •     Own compensation data quality and systems integrations in partnership with HRIS and Finance, including the ongoing Success Factors compensation themed dashboard enhancement and the team's ticketing system. •     Administer Annual Incentive Plan (AIP) tools and processes in partnership with the Director, Executive & Incentive Compensation, who owns AIP plan design and strategy. •     Develop and deliver People Business Partner (PBP) education on compensation programs, tools, and practices. •     Provide standby compensation support in partnership with Talent Management and Talent Acquisition for critical talent. M&A Readiness •     Serve as a broad-based compensation thought partner to leadership on transaction events (carve-outs, add-ons, integrations). •     Lead harmonization of base pay policies and job architecture post-deal, and alignment to value creation plans. Leadership & Collaboration •     Build and lead a high-performing global compensation team of five; develop capabilities in analytics, design, communications, and stakeholder management. •     Coach HR business partners and leaders on compensation decisions and communication; foster trust through consistent, well-explained practices. Qualifications •     10–15+ years of progressive experience in global broad-based compensation, including preferred experience in PE-backed portfolio companies. •     Proven ownership of broad-based compensation programs across multiple countries, including job architecture and market pricing. •     People leadership experience managing a distributed, multi-region team. •     Expertise in market pricing, pay structures, job architecture, and compensation program design. •     Strong financial acumen — able to model scenarios, evaluate affordability, and translate insights into decisions. •     Familiarity with global pay transparency laws (including EU Pay Transparency) and regulatory frameworks; experience partnering with Legal and Compliance. •     Advanced proficiency with compensation technologies and market data (e.g., SuccessFactors or equivalent; WTW/Mercer/Radford/Payscale; spreadsheet/modeling tools such as Excel, Power BI, etc.). •     Exceptional communication skills; comfortable preparing materials for senior leadership audiences. •     Bachelor's degree required Competencies •      Strategic Thinking: Connects broad-based compensation strategy to growth, productivity, and value creation. •      Analytical Rigor: Uses data to drive clear recommendations; quantifies trade-offs and risks. •      Judgment & Governance: Balances competitiveness with cost discipline and internal equity. •      Influence & Collaboration: Builds alignment across Finance, HR, and Geographies. •      Operational Excellence: Designs scalable processes with controls, documentation, and auditability. •      Change Leadership: Navigates complexity during transactions, reorganizations, or market shifts. •      People Leadership: Develops and motivates a global, multi-region team; delegates effectively. Success Metrics (12–18 months) •     Global broad-based compensation philosophy refreshed and codified for a high-performance, merit-based, private-ownership structure. •     Salary structures and job architecture harmonized across priority markets, with significant focus on manufacturing; measurable improvements in internal equity and market competitiveness. •     Global compensation cycle executed with high data quality and on-time delivery. •     EU Pay Transparency and other regulatory requirements met with documented, auditable processes. •     Enhanced job evaluation tool and web-based market pricing tool fully adopted across regions. •     Global team of five fully staffed, developed, and operating with clear role clarity and succession depth.

review_candidates.title: Chief Technology Officer
review_candidates.description: This role is part of our Prerender team, one of our largest brands at saas.group. Prerender is a dynamic rendering SaaS platform within the saas.group portfolio. Since 2017, we've revolutionized SEO practices by enabling search engines to crawl JavaScript-heavy sites seamlessly while preserving user experience. Thousands of companies worldwide trust our platform, which serves over 2.7 billion unique pages to web crawlers and drives results for enterprises and growing businesses alike. Profile Overview Prerender has built a platform that thousands of companies trust to serve billions of pages to web crawlers. Now we're evolving into something bigger: the layer that makes the web legible to machines, both the search crawlers that have always mattered and the AI systems that increasingly decide what people find. To get there, we need to transform how we build product. We're looking for a Chief Technology Officer (CTO) to lead that transformation, shifting our engineering organization from infrastructure-optimization to a high-velocity, product-focused team that moves fast and ships features that matter. This is a building role, not a caretaker role. You'll own the technology vision, set the engineering strategy, and have authority over the R&D budget, team, and technical direction. You'll embed AI-first engineering practices, make smart infrastructure tradeoffs, and build the improvement motion that makes delivery faster and keeps it that way. You'll lead a small, senior engineering team — around seven engineers today — supported by shared platform and DevOps resources from saas.group's central team. There is no management layer between you and the engineers, which puts you close to the work and means the leadership has to come from you. So we need someone hands-on enough to augment the team, not to manage it from a distance, and who can do that without losing hold of the strategy and the responsibilities only this role carries. We need deep technical expertise, a strong infrastructure background, and a proven track record of transforming engineering teams at SaaS companies. Your responsibilities Technology Vision and Strategy: Own the technology vision, roadmap, and engineering strategy for Prerender. Align engineering work with business objectives and customer value. Lead adoption of AI-assisted development tooling to multiply team productivity; own the quality bar for what it produces. Drive architecture and infrastructure decisions with a holistic view of TCO that includes maintenance burden and engineering opportunity cost, not just hosting spend. Run a multi-region, Kubernetes-based render fleet efficiently: cost per render, reliability, and the operational hygiene that keeps both from drifting. Represent Prerender's technical capabilities to customers, partners, and the broader market. Maintain high standards of software quality, performance, security, and reliability. Track shifts in technology and engineering practice, and bring the ones that change how we build into the team. Security and Compliance: Own security and compliance as a standing program. Prerender completes SOC 2 Type II and its ISO 27001 certification decision at the end of 2026; you inherit the year-two observation period, the surveillance audit, and the operational discipline that keeps both credible. Keep the program legible to someone other than you: named owners, current vendor and auditor contacts, and no single point of failure. Team Management and Growth: Coach and mentor engineers to reach their full potential. Set clear expectations and create opportunities for growth. People matter here. Build a culture of ownership, where engineers carry their decisions through instead of escalating them. Foster diversity and inclusion within the engineering organization. Execution and Delivery: Own the continuous improvement motion of delivery. The team finds and removes its own bottlenecks on a regular cadence. Enhance DevOps practices, CI/CD pipelines, and robust monitoring systems. Define and track engineering metrics that matter. Use data to identify bottlenecks and optimize workflows. Manage change deliberately. Changes to practice, process and infrastructure reach the people who have to run them — and, where customers are affected, the customers — with notice, consultation, and a route to raise a question before the change lands. Executive Partnership and Stakeholder Management: Partner with the CEO and leadership team on company strategy. Communicate technology progress to company leadership and the board. Work closely with Product to align engineering capacity with customer needs. Translate technical concepts for non-technical stakeholders and advocate for investments that drive business growth. Ownership & Autonomy: Own the full R&D budget including personnel, infrastructure, tooling, and vendor relationships. Run that budget as a managed number. Maintain an infrastructure cost model, report forecast against actual, and be able to say what a decision costs before it's made. Make the right decisions for engineering, aligned with company strategy, without second-guessing or micromanagement. What You bring to the table 10+ years in software engineering, with 5+ years in senior engineering leadership (VP/Director/CTO) at a SaaS company. Strong infrastructure background with experience running large-scale distributed systems and production Kubernetes, and making strategic tradeoffs between cost, maintenance burden, and engineering velocity. You've driven unit costs down on a fleet you owned. Demonstrated ability to embed AI tooling into engineering workflows and multiply team productivity , with a clear-eyed view of where it helps, where it produces plausible work that doesn't hold up, and how review standards survive the increase in volume. Proven experience coaching, mentoring, and developing engineering teams, ideally through a significant transformation. A track record of raising a team's delivery speed and keeping it raised long after the initial push, with the measurement and process change that made it stick. A record of landing process and platform change that sticks, with the people affected brought along before it landed. Experience owning a security and compliance program in a SaaS company — SOC 2, ISO 27001 or equivalent — as a continuing operational responsibility. Business-oriented and hands-on: you understand how engineering decisions connect to revenue and customer value, and you contribute directly alongside the team, through the same review and planning process as everyone else. Experience with scalable, high-performance web products, CI/CD, DevOps, and security principles. SEO or search-related experience is a plus. Excellent communication skills. Comfortable presenting to boards, working with executives, and collaborating cross-functionally. Communication is async-first in our remote environment, leaning on clear, timely updates with documentation up-to-date and readable and proactive context-sharing. What’s in it for You Ultimate flexibility: We're 100% remote. Work from wherever you like, whenever you like. Freedom and autonomy: High-trust environment with lots of independence to solve problems your way, with support when you need it. Minimum bureaucracy: We stay efficient and keep momentum sustainable. No death by meetings. Real impact: This is a C-level role with a seat at the executive table, board visibility, and the mandate to transform how we build product. Small & friendly team: We help each other out, have fun, and don't take ourselves too seriously. Our network: Access to a community of SaaS professionals across the saas.group portfolio who regularly exchange ideas and expertise. Flexible time off: Recharge when you need to. Learning Budget: Generous budget for classes, conferences, books, and other learning resources. Prerender is part of saas.group, and we have a shared goal of succeeding together. What is saas.group? Think of us as the driving catalyst behind your favorite software success stories. saas.group, established in 2017, is on a mission to turbocharge promising B2B SaaS ventures, unlocking their full potential. As a Software-as-a-Service portfolio powerhouse, we specialize in acquiring small software treasures and polishing them into industry stars. With a dynamic, fully remote team of nearly 380+ colleagues spanning 50+ countries we are truly global and we are rewriting the playbook on SaaS innovation and collaboration. We grow 25 exciting brands under our umbrella. Feel free to explore our Candidate's Hub to get an insider's view, dive into our culture, gain valuable insights into our teams and how we work. Also, don’t forget to follow saas.group on LinkedIn to stay up-to-date on our job openings, podcast episodes, and with all things happening at our company. We don’t just simply offer you to “take a job with us” but rather to “join us on this journey” to build the world's largest platform of independent SaaS companies. Sounds like something you’re up for? Feel free to apply even if you don’t check all these boxes. We believe in the power of diversity and fresh perspectives to spice up our team. Your application might just be the missing ingredient!

review_candidates.title: CEO - Construction Business
review_candidates.description: Role Description The CEO – Construction Business will lead the development, growth, and overall performance of MIH’s construction-focused business unit in Lahore. This full-time, on-site role includes setting strategic direction, overseeing operations, and ensuring projects are delivered on time, within budget, and to quality and safety standards. The CEO will manage senior stakeholders, build and maintain client relationships, and drive business development, including identifying opportunities, negotiating contracts, and expanding the portfolio. Day-to-day responsibilities include leading cross-functional teams, monitoring financial performance, optimizing processes, and ensuring compliance with regulatory and industry requirements. The CEO will also mentor leaders, foster a high-performance culture, and collaborate with MIH’s learning and HR experts to support talent development within the construction business. Qualifications Strong leadership, strategic planning, and decision-making skills, with a track record of leading business units or organizations in the construction sector. Proficiency in construction project management, including budget oversight, timeline management, quality assurance, and safety compliance. Experience in business development, client relationship management, contract negotiation, and market expansion within construction or related industries. Financial and commercial acumen, including P&L management, forecasting, cost control, and risk management. Ability to build, lead, and develop diverse teams, with strong communication, stakeholder management, and conflict resolution skills. Familiarity with local construction regulations, standards, and best practices in Lahore and the broader region. Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering, Construction Management, Business Administration, or a related field; a Master’s degree or MBA is an advantage. Experience collaborating with HR, learning, and organizational development functions to support talent and organizational growth is beneficial. Capacity to work on-site in Lahore and travel to project locations as needed.

review_candidates.title: CAD Automation Engineer
review_candidates.description: CAD Automation Engineer (Python / NX Open / Computational Geometry / AI) About the Role; We are seeking a highly skilled CAD Automation Engineer to join an innovative engineering automation project focused on developing advanced software solutions integrated with professional CAD platforms. In this role, you will design and develop automation tools that interact directly with CAD environments, process structured geometric data, and support intelligent feature recognition capabilities. You will work at the intersection of software engineering, computational geometry, CAD automation, and applied AI , contributing to the development of scalable and high-performance engineering solutions. This position is ideal for candidates who enjoy solving complex technical challenges involving geometry processing, algorithm development, and engineering software systems. Key Responsibilities Develop and maintain CAD automation tools and workflows using Python. Integrate, customize, and extend CAD platforms through APIs, preferably NX Open or equivalent CAD frameworks. Design and implement algorithms for geometric analysis, feature recognition, and pattern matching. Process and analyze geometric and parametric data structures to extract engineering parameters and insights. Build scalable backend services and automation pipelines for engineering applications. Optimize performance and efficiency of geometry-intensive computations. Collaborate closely with engineering and product teams to translate business requirements into technical solutions. Contribute to the integration of AI/ML techniques for classification, recognition, and intelligent automation use cases. Ensure software quality through testing, documentation, and continuous improvement practices. Required Qualifications Strong professional experience in Python development. Hands-on experience with CAD automation and CAD APIs (NX Open preferred). Solid understanding of computational geometry, geometric algorithms, or geometry processing. Experience developing algorithmic, data-processing, or engineering software systems. Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving skills. Familiarity with engineering data structures and technical software environments. Ability to work independently in a remote, collaborative environment. Preferred Qualifications Experience with computer vision or image-based feature extraction techniques. Knowledge of optimization algorithms, search techniques, or matching systems. Experience working with industrial engineering or manufacturing software. Understanding of parametric modeling concepts and workflows. Exposure to AI/ML applications in engineering environments. Nice to Have Experience with Siemens NX or similar enterprise CAD platforms. Knowledge of graph-based algorithms, geometric similarity analysis, or topology-based processing. Background in mechanical engineering, manufacturing, or industrial automation. Experience developing intelligent engineering tools or digital engineering solutions. Why Join? Work on cutting-edge engineering automation technologies. Contribute to innovative projects combining CAD, geometry processing, and AI. Fully remote working environment. Opportunity to collaborate with highly skilled engineering and software development teams. Interested candidates are encouraged to apply with their updated CV and relevant project experience in CAD automation, computational geometry, or engineering software development.
